title: ochrocarpos odoratus
intro: Ochrocarpos odoratus, commonly known as the sweet woodruff or wild vanilla, is a perennial herb belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant is known for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion, as well as its antioxidant properties, which help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Ochrocarpos odoratus include its sedative and antiseptic properties, making it a potential remedy for anxiety and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
